name: Tesla
look: Radical subtraction — full-viewport photography, no shadows or borders anywhere, one blue reserved for the primary action.

hero.title: Lumen S
hero.sub: 643km of range. Order online for delivery in six weeks.

features.title: Designed for range
features.sub: Every decision in the car was made to move a kilometre further on the same energy.

items.title: 643km of range
items.body: A structural pack with larger cells carries more energy in less mass, because the pack is part of the body rather than bolted beneath it.

items.title: Charge in 15 minutes
items.body: Up to 275km of range added in a quarter of an hour at a Lumen charger, with the route planner preconditioning the pack on approach.

items.title: 0.208 drag coefficient
items.body: Flush handles, a sealed underbody and active cooling shutters. Aerodynamics buy more range than a bigger battery would.

items.title: Five-star rated
items.body: The lowest rollover risk recorded for a production saloon, and a front crumple zone with no engine in it.

items.title: Updates overnight
items.body: The car improves while it is parked. Range, ride and driver assistance have all been revised since delivery.

items.title: Room for five
items.body: A flat floor, no transmission tunnel, and 793 litres of storage across two compartments.

showcases.title: The pack is the floor
showcases.body: Cells are bonded into a structural pack that forms the floor of the car. It is stiffer than a conventional body, lighter than a pack plus a floor, and it puts the mass under the axle line where it belongs.

showcases.title: Charging that plans itself
showcases.body: Enter a destination and the car routes through chargers, preconditions the pack before each stop, and tells you how long to stay. You do not think about charging; you think about arriving.

testimonial.quote: I have not been to a petrol station in four years. That is the part nobody mentions in the reviews, and it is the part that actually changed my week.
testimonial.name: Anders Holm

pricing.title: Order online
pricing.sub: No dealership, no negotiation. The price is the price.

items.a: Six weeks for Long Range and Performance from a European build slot. Plaid is currently ten to twelve weeks. The estimate updates on your order page as the slot is confirmed.

items.q: Can I trade in my current car?
items.a: Yes, online. Answer six questions, receive a firm offer within a day, and the value is deducted from the balance due at delivery.
Four years or 80,000km on the vehicle, and eight years or 240,000km on the battery and drive unit with a minimum 70 percent capacity retention.

items.q: Do I need a home charger?
items.a: No, but most owners install one. A standard socket adds about 15km per hour of charging; a wall connector adds about 70km per hour.

cta.title: Order Lumen S
cta.sub: Delivery in six weeks. Order online in about four minutes.

notes: Full-viewport photography carries the page. Sections stack as edge-to-edge image bands with the UI floating on top.
There are no shadows, gradients, borders or patterns anywhere. If an element needs separating, use space or a change of image.
One blue, used exclusively for the primary action. Secondary buttons are translucent white or grey — never a second hue.
The nav floats over the hero with no background, border or shadow, trusting the photography to provide contrast.
Button labels are uppercase with light tracking, and the radius stays at 4px throughout — soft, but never a pill.
